items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-10-12
items.q: Arthur Johnson. I'm not the Johnson's brother.

ctx.x: So I went down to a four. Four is kind of hard. It's called a grain of the wood. Now here's a three and a half or three. But these have a more time. I found out this testing regime, you know what I mean? And then I found out that there's a lot of things that I found out. This testing regime, you know what I mean? It don't mean that the readers good. That's the only thing in there. I had to end this year, the slip, of course. But some diamond grain, you know. I was a king. Now for a card, I don't like. No classic…

the music better. You can hear the rhythm and the rhythm is the most important thing in the band. You can hear the rhythm. You got good rhythm. That's what Lawrence was living in. Fred could hear better. Joe. They did put on. You could hear the band and you only got the rhythm there. Joe said I worked him hard. I didn't work him hard. I mean he worked his own self hard. And then if you got the band you got the work man hard. Because most of the leaders don't want to work. They want to put their arm on their lap.…

I try to play in one way, the bands play in another. I like to play low register. I'm trying to play Mario Blasch. There was a mic that beat this one. Those old men didn't know mic in those days. But we played whenever we were. I had to play low register. There's one thing a text we're going to be running out soon. I wanted to mention, if you could say something about, and this is this time when you were playing out of Bunky, just before Bill Russell came down here in 42. Could you just say something about that…

items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: the Cody Jones and Freddie King, Arthur Johnson.

ctx.x: He's not here. He had to live for dear The Raw Airs and the Drum and D of the Winners. His brother, we just called him Duck Winners. He was a man of peace. We all sat together, Walter Preston. The Duck Winners, the Bad John Bees, myself, I'm Carmen, Chris, and I picked up Ricard. He picked up the second boy. And Roy, and the Trammell's, the Cody Jones and Freddie King, Arthur Johnson. And then after that, Chris Babich was so good to manage, manually. He had a recoglu of Chris. Re-coglu of Chris. You know, Dick…
What do you mean to new boy Chris? What do you mean to new boy Chris? What do you mean to new manson about Chris?
